ns2:section.sectionText: Urban sustainability is one of the most important concepts in the world today, requiring the ability to understand environmental, economic, and social processes individually and in concert. This course will incorporate sustainability initiatives and expertise from multiple departments on campus and within the local and regional context to introduce students to both the theory and practice of how buildings and cities can have a reduced or even positive impact on their environments. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshman. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman class standing.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
